definitions.explanation: A colored liquid applied to surfaces for protection or decoration, typically oil-based paint.

examples.japanese: ペンキの{匂|にお}いがする。

notes:
ペンキ comes from Dutch "pek" and refers mainly to oil-based paints for buildings and objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペンキを{塗|ぬ}る (to apply paint)
- ペンキ{塗|ぬ}りたて (wet paint)
- ペンキが{乾|かわ}く (for paint to dry)
- ペンキが{剥|は}げる (for paint to peel off)

RELATED WORDS:
- {塗料|とりょう} - paint/coating (technical term)
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ} - art paint/pigments
- ラッカー - lacquer
- ニス - varnish

Note: ペンキ typically refers to oil-based paints for walls, fences, etc., while {絵|え}の{具|ぐ} is used for art paints.
